anti_patterns.action: Bypassing rear pneumatic pressure switch with an electrical jumper wire
anti_patterns.consequence: Causes servo amplifier burnout, uncontrolled axis drop, and voids machine warranty.

anti_patterns.action: Taping or mechanically wedging door interlock switches in closed state
anti_patterns.consequence: Severe OSHA safety violation; allows spindle operation with enclosure open.

diagnostic_paths.title: Pneumatic Pressure Verification & Valve Reset (Rapid Triage)
diagnostic_paths.description: Quick 5-minute pneumatic line check and E-stop reset on the rear panel.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps:
1. Inspect the pneumatic pressure gauge on the rear air/lube panel (must read >= 85 PSI).
2. Check if the Emergency Stop button is physically depressed; twist clockwise to release.
3. Verify enclosure doors are fully closed and interlocks engaged.
4. Press the control panel RESET button twice to re-energize servo drives.
diagnostic_paths.prohibited_actions: Do not bypass or tape down door interlock switches.

diagnostic_paths.title: Low Voltage Power Supply & Relay Inspection (Deep Diagnostic)
diagnostic_paths.description: 45-minute electrical cabinet diagnostic for Maincon PCB low voltage supply and axis servo relays.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps:
1. Perform Lock-Out / Tag-Out (LOTO) on main breaker.
2. Open electrical cabinet and verify DC bus discharge light is OFF.
3. Measure low-voltage power supply at Maincon PCB: Yellow/Black (+12VDC) and White/Black (-12VDC).
4. Inspect servo amplifier fault LEDs and re-seat loose ribbon connectors.
diagnostic_paths.prohibited_actions: NEVER touch electrical contacts without verifying zero DC bus voltage.

anti_patterns.action: Pouring external cold water or ice directly onto ceramic heater bands
anti_patterns.consequence: Causes thermal shock cracking of the barrel cylinder and explosive steam.

anti_patterns.action: Increasing Zone 1 temperature to compensate for Zone 2 overheat
anti_patterns.consequence: Causes polymer melt degradation, nozzle drool, and catastrophic thermal runaway.

diagnostic_paths.title: Thermocouple Calibration & Cooling Water Purge (Quick Fix)
diagnostic_paths.description: 8-minute thermocouple seating verification and cooling jacket flow check.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps:
1. Inspect Zone 2 thermocouple connector for loose wiring or thermal paste degradation.
2. Verify barrel cooling water solenoid valve is opening and water manifold flow indicator is spinning.
3. Lower Zone 2 temperature setpoint by 5°C on CC300 controller to stabilize thermal overshoot.
diagnostic_paths.prohibited_actions: Do not touch barrel heat blankets directly without thermal protective gloves.

diagnostic_paths.title: Solid State Relay (SSR) & Heater Band Replacement (Hardware Fix)
diagnostic_paths.description: 50-minute SSR contactor inspection and ceramic heater band replacement.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps:
1. LOTO electrical enclosure and barrel heater circuits.
2. Test SSR 2K1 for closed-circuit short (stuck ON condition).
3. Measure resistance across Zone 2 ceramic band heater terminals.
4. Replace defective SSR or heater band assembly.
diagnostic_paths.prohibited_actions: Do not power on heater circuits with open thermocouple circuit.

title: X Axis SERVO ERROR TOO LARGE

anti_patterns.action: Forcing the stuck X-axis leadscrew with a pry bar or sledgehammer
anti_patterns.consequence: Permanent brinelling damage to precision ballscrew bearings.

diagnostic_paths.title: Ballscrew Way Lube & Chip Clearance
diagnostic_paths.description: 10-minute mechanical chip clearance and manual way-lube flush.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps:
1. Remove chips and swarf from X-axis telescoping way covers.
2. Trigger manual lubrication cycle via M161/M162.
3. Hand-jog X axis in .001 increments to verify free travel without binding.
diagnostic_paths.prohibited_actions: Never force the axis with a pry bar.

diagnostic_paths.title: X-Axis Servo Motor Encoder & Belt Tensioning
diagnostic_paths.description: 35-minute encoder feedback test and drive belt retensioning.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps:
1. Inspect X-axis motor coupling and encoder belt for backlash or tooth wear.
2. Verify encoder signal cable shielding is grounded to chassis.
3. Adjust timing belt tension to 45 lbs deflection.
diagnostic_paths.prohibited_actions: Do not overtighten belt beyond manufacturer spec.

anti_patterns.action: Adjusting mechanical high-pressure relief valve beyond 210 bar max rating
anti_patterns.consequence: Ruptures hydraulic manifold seals and creates high-pressure oil injection hazard.

diagnostic_paths.title: Hydraulic Reservoir Level & Filter Check
diagnostic_paths.description: 5-minute fluid level verification and return filter differential check.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps:
1. Check hydraulic sight glass on main power unit (must be > 60% full).
2. Inspect return line pressure filter indicator (must be in green zone).
3. Top off with ISO VG 46 hydraulic fluid if level is low.
diagnostic_paths.prohibited_actions: Do not mix incompatible hydraulic oil grades.

diagnostic_paths.title: Proportional Pressure Valve Recalibration
diagnostic_paths.description: 40-minute proportional valve amplifier card tuning and transducer test.
diagnostic_paths.resolution_steps:
1. Connect pressure test gauge to tiebar-less clamp test port.
2. Calibrate proportional valve amplifier offset voltage.
3. Inspect proportional valve spool for particulate jamming.
diagnostic_paths.prohibited_actions: Do not adjust mechanical relief valve past 210 bar max rating.
